finding_rules.statement: One or more interactive commands were observed inside Cowrie. This is honeypot evidence, not evidence of activity on a real system.

basis: Migrated from reviewed SMB policy guidance

finding_rules.statement: Cowrie reported success for a parsed, supported inspection command in its simulated shell; result contents, malicious intent, compromise, and real-host effects are not established.

basis: Requires exactly one supported typed inspection operation with successful fragment outcome
All referenced paths and entities must resolve
ATT&CK candidates, predictions, enrichment, and hypotheses cannot select this finding
provenance.author: honeypot-policy-maintainer

finding_rules.statement: Cowrie reported success for a parsed, supported filesystem-change command in its simulated shell; the resulting filesystem state, malicious intent, persistence, cleanup, compromise, and real-host effects are not established.
